1.ja: חיניד' סבח מוסי' ובני אסראיל. הד'ה אלתסבחה ללה
1.en: At that time Moses and the sons of Israel sang this hymn of praise to God
1.he: אָז יָשִׁיר-מֹשֶׁה וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת-הַשִּׁירָה הַזֹּאת לַיהוָה

1.ja: וקאלו אגמעין. נסבח ללה אד' אקתדר אקתדארא
1.en: and they all said together: 'Let us praise God, for He has triumphed mightily
1.he: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֵאמֹר אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה כִּי-גָאֹה גָּאָה

1.ja: אלכ'יל ורכאבהא רמא בהם פי אלבחר
1.en: the horse and its rider He hurled into the sea.'

2.en: 'My strength and my glory is the Eternal
this is my stronghold — I take refuge in Him
the God of my father — I exalt Him.'

3.en: 'God is the master of battles — God is His name.'

4.ja: מראכב פרעון. וגנדה זדא בהם פי אלבחר
4.en: 'The chariots of Pharaoh and his army He swept away into the sea

4.ja: וכ'יאר קואדה ג'רקו פי בחר אלקלזם
4.en: and the choicest of his officers were drowned in the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea).'

5.en: they went down to the bottom like stones.'

6.en: 'Your right hand, O Lord, is great in power
Your right hand, O Lord, strikes terror into the enemies.'

7.en: 'And by Your abundant might You demolish Your adversaries
You send forth Your wrath — it consumes them like stubble.'

8.en: 'And by the wind of Your anger the water was heaped up
the flowing waters stood still like towering mountains
and the deep was frozen in the heart of the sea.'

9.en: 'When the enemy said: I will pursue them and overtake them
and divide their spoil — my soul shall have its fill of satisfaction from them
I shall draw my sword, and my hand shall cut them down.'

10.en: 'You blew with Your wind and the sea covered them
and they sank like lead in the mighty water.'

11.ja: מן מת'לך פי אלמעבודאת יא רב
11.en: 'Who is like You among the worshipped, O Lord
Who is like You, the majestic and the holy
awesome in praise, the maker of wonders?'

12.en: 'You stretched forth Your right hand — and the earth swallowed them.'

13.en: 'And You led in Your grace the people whom You redeemed
and You guided them in Your might to Your holy dwelling.'

14.en: and birth-pangs seized the inhabitants of Philistia.'

15.en: 'At that time the chiefs of Edom were dismayed
and the nobles of Moab — trembling seized them
and all the inhabitants of Canaan were convulsed.'

16.en: 'May dread and terror fall upon them
by the greatness of Your power may they be still as stone

16.ja: אלי' אן יגוז שעבך יא רב
16.en: until Your people pass over, O Lord

16.ja: אלי' אן יגוז אלשעב אלד'י מלכתהם
16.en: until the people pass over whom You have made Your own.'

17.ja: גואזא תאתי בהם. פתג'רסהם פי גבל נחלתך
17.en: 'One by one You shall bring them in and plant them on the mountain of Your inheritance
prepared as a dwelling for You; You have made it, O Lord, a holy abode
O Lord, Your hands have established it.'

18.en: 'God is King for ever and ever.'

19.ja: אד' דכ'ל כ'יל פרעון. ומראכבה. ופרסאנה פי אלבחר
19.en: For when the horses of Pharaoh, his chariots, and his horsemen entered into the sea
19.he: כִּי בָא סוּס פַּרְעֹה בְּרִכְבּוֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו בַּיָּם

19.en: God turned back upon them the waters of the sea

19.ja: וסארו בני אסראיל. פי אליבאס פי וסט אלבחר
19.en: and the sons of Israel walked on the dry land in the midst of the sea.
19.he: וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָלְכוּ בַיַּבָּשָׁה בְּתוֹךְ הַיָּם

20.ja: ת'ם אכד'ת מרים אלנבייה. אכת הרון. דפא פי ידהא
20.en: Then Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand
20.he: וַתִּקַּח מִרְיָם הַנְּבִיאָה אֲחוֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת-הַתֹּף--בְּיָדָהּ

20.ja: פכ'רג גמיע אלנסא וראהא. בדפוף וטבול
20.en: and all the women went out after her with tambourines and drums.

21.ja: וגאובתהן מרים. סבחו ללה אד' אקתדר אקתדארא
21.en: And Miriam led them in response: 'Praise God, for He has triumphed mightily
21.he: וַתַּעַן לָהֶם מִרְיָם שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כִּי-גָאֹה גָּאָה

21.ja: אלכ'יל ורכאבהא רמא בהם פי אלבחר
21.en: the horse and its rider He hurled into the sea.'

22.ja: ורחל מוסי' בני אסראיל מן בחר אלקלזם
22.en: And Moses moved the sons of Israel on from the Sea of Qulzum
and they went out into the wilderness of Shur

22.ja: וסארו ת'לאתה' איאם. פי אלברייה ולם יגדו מאא
22.en: and they traveled three days in the wilderness and found no water.

23.ja: וגאו אלי' אלמרירה. ולם יטיקו אן ישרבו מנהא מאא
23.en: And they came to the Bitterness, and they could not drink water from it
23.he: וַיָּבֹאוּ מָרָתָה--וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לִשְׁתֹּת מַיִם מִמָּרָה

23.en: and therefore it was named the Bitterness.

24.ja: פתד'מר אלקום. עלי' מוסי קאילין מא נשרב
24.en: And the people murmured against Moses, saying: 'What shall we drink?'

25.en: And he cried out to God

25.ja: פדלה עלי' שגרה. טרח מנהא פי אלמא פחלא
25.en: and He directed him to a tree, and he cast branches of it into the water, and it became sweet
25.he: וַיּוֹרֵהוּ יְהוָה עֵץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ אֶל-הַמַּיִם וַיִּמְתְּקוּ הַמָּיִם

25.en: There He established for them ordinances and laws
and there He put them to the test.

26.ja: וקאל אן קבלת אמר אללה רבך
26.en: And He said: 'If you accept the command of God your Lord
26.he: וַיֹּאמֶר אִם-שָׁמוֹעַ תִּשְׁמַע לְקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ

26.en: and do what is right in His sight

26.ja: ואנצתת אלי' וצאיאה. וחפצ'ת גמיע רסומה
26.en: and hearken to His commandments, and keep all His ordinances

26.ja: פגמיע אלאמראץ'. אלתי אחללתהא באלמצריון לא אחל פיך שייא מנהא
26.en: then all the diseases which I brought upon the Egyptians I shall bring upon you none of them
for I am God your healer.'

27.ja: ות'ם את'ני עשר עין מא וסבעין נכ'לה
27.en: and there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees
27.he: וְשָׁם שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה עֵינֹת מַיִם וְשִׁבְעִים תְּמָרִים

27.en: and they encamped there by the water.
